tools.name: list_stations
tools.description: List the 16 supported UK stations and canonical URLs.

tools.name: get_departures
tools.description: Read up to 20 eligible departures from a cached board. Cold caches are unavailable; preserve freshness, coverage and attribution.

tools.name: next_train
tools.description: Next listed eligible cached train from one catalogue station to another, terminating or calling there. No journey planning or completeness guarantee.

tools.name: platform_for
tools.description: Qualified platform sentence for an exact cached service_id at a station. Plans and history are never reports.
